expected_differences: The signed-in account name and D initial correctly replace Maya’s fixture identity and portrait.
Activity shows four real To do records, with In review and History counts, rather than Home’s discovery filters and open opportunities.
The $30.00, $75.00, $25.00 and $300.00 amounts retain their record-specific payment bases instead of copying the Lab’s fixture amounts.
Request for you, Changes requested, Accepted and Awaiting installation correctly produce different next-action labels.
Record-specific thumbnails retain their differing proportions and content; they should not be replaced with the Lab’s coffee reference, Story creative or vehicle photograph.
keep: Mineral canvas, #101820 graphite identity/navigation rail, restrained dividers and flat operational rows without enclosing cards or shadows.
The separate source column beside the title, status and work-identification stack, with information and money beginning 24px below the source reservation on desktop.
18/24px, weight-500 task titles and 16/20px view labels; longer work identification wraps without clipping.
Right-aligned, bold ink amounts with an explicit payment basis immediately underneath. Activity does not need Home’s large cobalt opportunity ledges.
Literal amber attention states and green Accepted text, with cobalt concentrated on selected navigation and view indicators.
The desktop rail’s Home, Activity, Earnings and Profile order, plus account switching, Search, Messages and Notifications.
review.readiness_note: Sign off visually at 1440×900. The capture supports preservation of records, workflow states, action entry points and navigation; it does not establish successful routing, mutations, keyboard operation or behavior at other viewports.
review.why: This is a faithful translation of the system to Activity, not an inappropriate copy of Home. The 200px graphite rail and mineral working field establish the approved surface hierarchy. Each compact, ratio-preserving source leads into a visibly lower information-and-money plane, making the desktop 24px handoff meaningful without decorative notches. All four records fit in view, matching the selected To do count. Amounts remain consistently aligned and distinguish approval-based, approved-version and monthly payment. Action wording agrees with each literal state: requests invite acceptance or decline, revisions request another upload, accepted Story work requests posting and proof, and installation-stage work exposes the booking. Nothing visible substitutes fixture content, invents progress or obscures the real workflow.
review.verdict: Pass 3 faithfully transfers Frame Shift to desktop Activity while preserving TapMart’s visible real-data workflow and navigation.
